name: minoxidil + rosemary
uses: 1.Naturally activate hair follicles and promote hair regrowth. 2.Extend the hair growth cycle,enhance hair resilience, and effectively reduce hair loss. 3.Balance scalp sebum secretion and optimize the scalp tissue microenvironment.
otcwarn: Your hair loss is sudden or patchy. Your hair loss is associated with childbirth. You do not know the reason for your hair loss. You are under 18 years of age. Do not use on babies and children. Your scalp is red, inflamed, infected, irritated, or painful. You use other medicines on the scalp
